requirements.text: The system shall ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately, implementing double-entry bookkeeping principles to maintain integrity.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions, with logs timestamped and error-checked for at least 6 years.
The system shall implement error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring users can access essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate and efficiently execute currency conversions for accurate financial transactions.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain transparency.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement energy-efficient logging techniques while maintaining a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
The system shall conduct an energy impact assessment on the retention period to ensure compliance with sustainability objectives.
